cards.card_text: He calls it "a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation…" Peter, an apostle of Jesus, quotes this stone line in his first letter and applies it to Jesus (1 Peter 2:4-6).
cards.verse_text: So this is what the Lord GOD says: “See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation; the one who believes will never be shaken.
